incidents.name: Audius Governance proxy re-initialization
incidents.notes: A storage-layout collision in the Audius upgradeable proxies left the Initializable `initialized` flag sharing a slot with another variable, so the attacker re-called Governance.initialize() to install himself as guardian and then evaluated a self-submitted proposal moving 18.5M AUDIO out of the community treasury.

sources.ref: onchain review: Governance proxy 0x4deca517d6817b6510798b7328f2314d3003abac created 2020-10-22 by 0xde21d46753633a177223faa6e56e8f6cd24cca04 (Audius deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xa0c7bd318d69424603cbf91e9969870f21b8ab4c; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events (Audius uses its own AudiusAdminUpgradeabilityProxy, upgrades go through a registry) so the age is measured from proxy deployment and may be overstated; the exploit sequence was 0xfefd829e246002a8fd061eede7501bccb6e244a9aacea0ebceaecef5d877a984 (re-initialize + proposal), 0x3c09c6306b67737227edc24c663462d870e7c2bf39e9ab66877a980c900dd5d5 (vote) and this evaluateProposal tx that executed the treasury transfer; ~18.5M AUDIO valued at ~$6.1M were taken and later sold for 704 ETH (~$1.08M realized)

deployment-basis recheck (storage, not events): the Governance proxy's single DELEGATECALL in the attack tx goes to 0x35dd16dfa4ea1522c29ddd087e8f076cad0ae5e8, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot holds exactly that address at the creation block 11103280, at the incident block 15201799 and at all 201 evenly spaced samples in between; the proxy runtime is byte-identical at both blocks. The current implementation 0x1c91af03a390b4c619b444425b3119e553b5b44b was installed only after the hack. The age is therefore not overstated: 639.9 days from deployment is the real figure.
